notes: «وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is an unnamed group of teachers, co-transmitter with the father at the first level
«أبي عبد الله (ع)» is an Imam written inside the chain after «عن»: narrator, as written (ruling 2); no name completed
the bracketed «[يُحِبُّونَ إِذَا زَارَ الرَّجُلُ]» is a textual variant in the saying, not a link
